        r"^\+(  %t\d+ = )invoke ptr @pys_getenv\((.*?)\) to label %L(\d+) unwind label %L(\d+)$",

    target = int(target_text)
    original_call = assigned + "call ptr @pys_getenv(" + arguments + ")"
    assert "-" + original_call in report.splitlines()
    assert re.search(r"^-.*invoke .* unwind label %L" + unwind + r"$", report, re.M)
    continuation_removals = 0
    restored_calls = 0
    identifier_rewrites = 0

    def restore_identifier(match):
        global identifier_rewrites
        prefix, number = match.groups()
        value = int(number)
        if value > target:
            identifier_rewrites += 1
            return prefix + str(value - 1)
        return match.group(0)

    for hunk_index, header in enumerate(headers):
        end = headers[hunk_index + 1].start() if hunk_index + 1 < len(headers) else len(report)

        new = [line[1:] for line in lines if line[:1] in (" ", "+")]
        assert len(old) == int(header.group(2)), (path, hunk_index, "old line count")
        assert len(new) == int(header.group(4)), (path, hunk_index, "new line count")
        restored = []

                continuation_removals += 1

                assert line == (assigned + "invoke ptr @pys_getenv(" + arguments

                line = original_call
                restored_calls += 1

            # names, string-pool indices, operand types and instruction order
            # are kept exact in the comparison below.
            line = re.sub(r"(%[Lt]|^L)(\d+)\b", restore_identifier, line)
            restored.append(line)

    diff_file = destination / (str(index).zfill(2) + "-" + Path(path).stem + ".diff")
    diff_file.write_text("DIFF " + part)
    results.append({
        "path": path,
        "hunk_count": len(headers),
        "inserted_continuation": "L" + target_text,
        "existing_unwind_handler": "L" + unwind,
        "identifier_occurrences_shifted_by_one": identifier_rewrites,
        "getenv_call_to_invoke": 1,
        "other_instruction_or_operand_changes": 0,
        "full_diff": str(diff_file),

The added unwind target matches an existing invoke handler in that function.",
    "result": "All 59 hunks in all 28 differing cases contain only the intended getenv exception edge and continuation block plus induced local label/SSA identifier renumbering.",
    "cases_reviewed": results,
